thread:
maria: Heads-up — planning a micro-throttle rollup to shift traffic blue->green for service-search in eu-west1 on 2026-03-22 23:00 UTC. Canary progression: 2% -> 10% -> 25% -> 100%. Drain window 3m between steps. Rollback criteria listed below. Any objections?
kevin: ack. quick q — session affinity/cookie stickiness handled?
sam: will watch dashboards for latency and 5xx during the run. Add smoke tests.
maria: yes, cookie stickiness preserved (router cookie pinning). We'll update weights via routerctl script. Runbook: prewarm shadow 5% to populate KV cache, then canaries.
sam: adding checks: p95 latency, 5xx rate, tokenization errors, and embedding pipeline failures.
maria: rollback triggers: p95 > 200ms OR 5xx% > 1.5% sustained 5m OR tokenization errors > 0.5% sustained 3m OR OOM on green nodes. Auto-rollback enabled.
deploy-bot: scheduled shift id shift-20260322-2310 for service-search in eu-west1. Command: `/run shift --id shift-20260322-2310 --canaries 2,10,25,100 --drain 180s --auto-rollback true`
ops-oncall: @maria assign me as handler for the window. I'll be on-call 22:45-00:15 UTC.
kevin: any LB/router infra changes we should coordinate with edge?
maria: routerops will run gradual-weight updates, script e.g.:
```
routerctl set-weight search-service green 2 && sleep 180
routerctl set-weight search-service green 10 && sleep 180
routerctl set-weight search-service green 25 && sleep 180
routerctl set-weight search-service green 100
```
We'll also prewarm by shadowing 5% earlier to warm caches.
sam: +1 on shadow prewarm. Add a smoke curl after the 10% step for 2m: `curl -H "x-trace: ev" https://eu-west1.search/internal/health?mode=smoke`
deploy-bot: step 1 completed: green at 2% (ts 1717702520). metrics: p95=86ms, errors=0.2%.
maria: nice. proceed to 10% in 5m.
deploy-bot: step 2 completed: green at 10% (ts 1717702780). metrics: p95=92ms, errors=0.4%. smoke tests passed.
skevin: seeing a small uptick in tokenization errors in the logs (not user-facing yet), tagging: #tokenizer.
sam: watching. If tokenization errors > 0.5% abort.
deploy-bot: step 3 initiated: shifting to 25% (ts 1717702920). holding for drain 180s.
deploy-bot: ALERT: tokenization errors increased to 1.9% in the last 3m — auto-rollback triggered. Rolling back to blue 100% (ts 1717703000). rollback-run id rb-20260322-2310.
maria: on it. confirm rollback completed and filing incident. Will also revert any temp LB tweaks.
ops-oncall: confirmed rollback complete. routing is back to blue 100%. Created incident INC-20260322-01 and archived traces to s3://redwood-incidents/2026/03/22/shift-2310.
skevin: repro'd tokenization spike locally — looks like model variant mismatch: green was v3.4, blue v3.3. Sending patch to standardize tokenizer version.
sam: follow-up: add a preflight model-version gate to deploy-bot; fail shift if model-version != pinned. Also add a shadow diff test comparing v3.4 outputs on a small prompt set before any traffic shift.
maria: agreed. Action items: (1) add model-version gate to deploy-bot, (2) update runbook with shadow prewarm + smoke test, (3) add release note blurb about rollup and rollback. I'll open PRs and tag the release notes. Thanks all :thumbsup:
